name: machine hands debated, not shown placing
what_it_changes: P14 says members add placements with scripts, bots and spare accounts, and argue over them. In these rooms only the arguing part shows: scripts are offered, debated, refused or attributed to outsiders, and the room's own machine placement is not shown.
why: Cut rules R1 and R2 (tree-D4.md), with R1a (the level): the key's lines, read whole in _analysis/d4a02_keys/restrict_P14_T4-009.txt, state one shared change to P14. R1a: T3-027 holds 14 of the 27 rooms and T3-028 11, so the branch is declared at the fourth order. 'Script debate and explicit refusal must be distinguishable from local adoption' (mindcrack); 'The record establishes script provision and reception but does not establish execution or additional placements' (rutgers). These are the labelers' how sentences.
